text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While we were discussing the training menu,
Rhein Kraft suddenly clutched her head.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I don't feel feverish, so
I don't think it's a cold, but...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Still... the weather forecast
didn't make it sound that bad..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Also... maybe it's because
I took too long of a nap... or something?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...The more I think about it,
the worse my headache gets~..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft ended up suffering
from a headache for a while.
